title: GEA Survival Risk Stratifier
question: Which combination of molecular features best predicts chemotherapy response and survival in GEA?
dataset_target: TCGA-STAD via GDC API (clinical + mutations + MSI + immune subtype)
dataset_actual_poc: GBSG2 — German Breast Cancer Study Group 2 (Schumacher 1994), n=686, 299 events, via sksurv.datasets.load_gbsg2
substitution_reason: TCGA-STAD via cBioPortal not reachable from sandbox; GBSG2 is canonical published RCT for Cox PH benchmarking (Schumacher 1994 reports C-index 0.69–0.71 on Cox PH)
status: Runnable POC; full TCGA-STAD pipeline is a target that needs GDC API access
reproduce_command: pip install scikit-survival pandas numpy matplotlib && python scripts/poc/run_poc.py
limitations: GBSG2 is breast cancer, not GEA — pipeline validation only; biological interpretation is dataset-specific
Bootstrap CIs are approximate; sksurv does not expose per-coefficient SEs
Full TCGA-STAD pipeline needs GDC API + clinical/mutation/MSI/immune-subtype data acquisition, not run in sandbox
Synthetic-data generator mirrors TCGA structure but is NOT real patient data
Streamlit dashboard outputs are not for clinical use — for any deployment, validation on an independent prospective cohort, IRB oversight, and regulatory review would be required
portfolio_position: Project 6 of 7 — capstone integrating MSI (P1), immune subtype (P2), and SHAP-validated biomarkers (P3, P4) into a survival model
role: Pipeline architecture, biological feature selection from thesis, clinical-plausibility review of model outputs. Implementation AI-assisted.
